en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with rows of 2–3 story gabled houses along both sides of a broad market square. In the foreground, women in long dresses and aprons sell goods from tables and carts, suggesting an open‑air market. There is a tall column or pole near the center of the square. The caption in red Gothic-style script at the top reads "Hartha i. Sa. Marktplatz."
